text:
Labeling human for /do-beads filter. This is a workspace-wide canonical-template extension (the bead body itself says "Likely a P2 epic when picked up"). Per the do-beads-scope-selection-policy memory rule 2d, an unscoped session should not land only the canonical lead because it leaves 7 siblings half-propagated.

Specific decisions needed from Mark before this can be worked:

1. Trait surface — new SubscribeBackend trait, method on existing JmapBackend with default-impl polling, or testjig-internal mpsc plumbing only?
2. Sizing — decompose into epic with one child per sibling crate (mail-server canonical first, then chat/calendars/tasks/contacts/filenode/sharing/metadata), or keep this as a single bead and scope to testjig-internal only?
3. Signal payload shape — bare wake notification (consumer re-reads state) or per-type change vector?

Recommendation: option (1c) testjig-internal mpsc plumbing + option (2) single-bead scoped-to-testjig. Rationale: keeps the workspace *-server traits transport-less per the kit-vs-jig posture documented in AGENTS.md "What this workspace builds" section; testjig is the only workspace member that needs signal-driven push; can be promoted to a public *-server trait surface later if/when a real consumer pushes back.

Filed per AGENTS.md "Turn questions into beads" rule.
